title: Schedule of Fees and Charges for Rural Home Loans
content:
Fees and charges of the Rural Home Loans products, as published to members of the Country Home program. Amounts are in USD.

## Items of the schedule

- **Origination fee** — origination fee at closing, percent of original principal; **minimum origination fee** — minimum origination fee, USD.
- **Late charge percentage** — late charge on a monthly payment not received in full within the grace period, percent of the principal-and-interest portion; **minimum late charge** and **maximum late charge** — minimum and maximum late charge, USD.
- **Returned payment fee** — fee per returned payment, USD.
- **Prepayment penalty** — prepayment penalty, percent of principal prepaid; 0 means none (every Country Home product is penalty-free).

## Schedule

| Product | Origination fee (percent) | Minimum origination fee | Late charge percentage | Minimum late charge | Maximum late charge | Returned payment fee | Prepayment penalty (percent) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Country Home 15-Year Fixed | 1.0 | 750.00 | 5 | 15.00 | 300.00 | 30.00 | 0 |
| Country Home 20-Year Fixed | 1.0 | 750.00 | 5 | 15.00 | 300.00 | 30.00 | 0 |
| Country Home 30-Year Fixed | 1.0 | 750.00 | 5 | 15.00 | 300.00 | 30.00 | 0 |
| Country Home 5/6 Adjustable | 0.75 | 750.00 | 5 | 15.00 | 300.00 | 30.00 | 0 |
| Country Home 7/6 Adjustable | 0.75 | 750.00 | 5 | 15.00 | 300.00 | 30.00 | 0 |
| Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed | 1.0 | 2500.00 | 4 | 25.00 | 500.00 | 30.00 | 0 |

## Notes

- The two adjustable products carry the lower origination percentage of 0.75; the Country Home Jumbo 30-Year Fixed carries the higher minimum origination fee of 2500.00 and the different late charge figures of 4 percent, 25.00 and 500.00.
- The returned payment fee of 30.00 and the absence of any prepayment penalty are the same on all six products.
- *Hypothetical illustration of the origination minimum:* on a Country Home 30-Year Fixed loan of 60000.00 the percentage gives 600.00, below the minimum, so the origination fee is 750.00; on a loan of 90000.00 the percentage gives 900.00, above the minimum, so the fee is 900.00.
